entries.description: An independent MCP server for NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS): active fire / thermal anomaly detections from VIIRS, MODIS, and Landsat retrieved with the user's own FIRMS MAP_KEY, the complete FIRMS FAQ and related documentation verbatim, and links into the FIRMS Fire Map. Not an official NASA service.
representativeQueries: are there any satellite fire detections near Boise, Idaho in the last 24 hours
how many VIIRS detections were there around Maui on 8 August 2023
what does a fire detection mean on the ground
what is the difference between VIIRS and MODIS active fire data
why are there fire detections in the middle of the South Atlantic Ocean
show me recent fire activity in southern California on the FIRMS map
for what dates is MODIS standard processing data available
download fire footprints for Canada for the last 7 days as KML
